title: Vancouver West detached-house parcel location index: Marpole
land_scope: 2026 legal_type=LAND and current parcel-point zoning in R1-1/FSD/RA-1; proxy, not a building-use finding
transit_distance: straight-line great-circle metres; rail routes plus bus routes 99 and R4 from current GTFS
frontage_method: parcel extent parallel to the nearest address-matched public-street centreline; approximate
amenity_distance: straight-line great-circle metres from parcel representative point to published facility point; not walking distance
development_screen: initial screen only; not a buildability conclusion; City approval and parcel-specific review required

width_confidence.method: corner flag, frontage ambiguity, long-to-short aspect ratio, and rectangle-fit area residual
